content: Peter ura beteram wore ko dugu duap balam
Judea lilim ko apostle alo se Kris alo den ikiman mu, sor saki ko kariimet Kaem ko den ikiman ale taman nongomang motam ningi beteman.
Bore te se, tom Peter peleram Jerusalem namaram, mu Kris alo nungumik guang batoga mu nu balu maguwukasan,
ale maman, “Ni kari nungumik guang me batoga wore nunga kawam ningi namerem ale nongorak na naem!” makasan.
Se Peter duap beteram ale kiwem suen la te aratam umu ko dugu duap ninguru nunga manarukaso, ale mam,

“Ani Joppa wonong te baga se guranek bitawa, kausa bo ipingira iwita arigem. Mu mel bo guang biya iwita, dun bo te koma singsang iluman ale dun komasang te betela koma singsang iluman, ale beteman se aninga te tai kaparam.
Se ani ningi loagerem ale giarum ko mel nusuwik nuguting te geraga mu, se ali ko gawitiru boromor se inangnang binga geragasan mu arigem.
Se kuring bo iwita aga manarukaso, ‘Peter, bares nunga moa noko,’ makaso.
“Bare ani maem, ‘Kari Biya, ani buta me bitirikko. Aninga agiring imi mel bo karur ago suwuta me kau to arigam,’ maem.
“Se kuring umu duruk wonong te udagi tala aking balam, ‘Mel Kaem nungam ale balam karur mena ma balam mu, ni balu ale karur ago ma me baluko,’ mam.
Munan umu tom ilagala suan ko aratam. Asele aking melmasak umu suen la tagiman se duruk wonong te tarigiram.
“Se me kam la, kari ilagala suan, ani ago ko Caesarea wore nunga beteman se tai kawam ani te bagerem mu te arataman.
Se Bur Laili ani nongorak namarikko mu me angamin yenerukko mam. Se nanga singsang 6 sanamiwasan imi mu ago agarak namaman. Ale nama kari den beteram mu ko kawam ningi kasu naguman.
Se nu engel bo ko kawam ningi aratam ale den balam mu nanga maonam, ‘Kari bo Joppa bagoso, ko nup Simon, arusan Peter masan, wore kete tairukko den bitar se kote namarukko.
Se nu den ni se ka kawam digo lilim ago ninga sangaru taukko mu, karogo tai ninga manukko.’
Peter ko den kunasaram ale mam, “Se ani den duap beterem ale nunga manaruwerem mu, Bur Laili nongote kaparam, giram ana nangate kaparam uwutatala nongote kaparam.
Se ani den Kari Biya nanga maonam mu angamin te tairam, ‘John yu te kariimet anuwa marak nungarukaso. Bare nina mu Bur Laili ko sokel te baptais talko,’ mam.

Ikialko, ana Kari Biya Jesus Kristus ko nangamang ningi nunguning aram se Kaem munan umu nangaram uwutatala, nuna nongomang ningi nunguning aram se nu munan umu nungaram. Se ani mu awiri wore Kaem ko gomang motam kalikko?” mam.

Se nuna Peter den balam mu ikiman ale tagira gurungumura mu menaram, se Kaem nup patawukasan ale balukasan, “Buta se Kaem kariimet sor saki ko wore karogotala, giris palagamon ale marak ningo tamonko lage korang kagaru nungaram,” makasan.
Kris alo Antioch sor te
Tom Stephen bita maguwuman se kueram mu te Kris alo nagu parasaman; ale Phoenicia, Cyprus, se Antioch nama gilingiman, ale Juda alo sor mu te bagara mu la den gilalong mu nunga manarukasan.
Bare saki mu Cyprus se Cyrene kari, nuna Antioch namaman ale Greek kari agotala Kari Biya Jesus ko den gilalong nunga manarukasan.
Se Kari Biya ko sokel nuna nongorak bagakaso, se kariimet suen biya giris palagaman ale Kari Biya ko nongomang ningi nunguning aram.
Se munan aratukaso umu ko den nama sios Jerusalem mu te aratam, se nuna Barnabas beteman se Antioch namaram.
Tom nu nama aratam mu, nu Kaem ko gomang lila ko munan nunga ningi arigam ale amilmilaram. Ale tom suen biya nongomang motam nunguning te Kari Biya ilukuawumonko den sangam mu nungarukaso.
Barnabas mu kari ningo, nu gomang ningi nunguning aora biya se Bur Laili ago terong mam, se kariimet suen biya nunga saongam se Kari Biya ko nongomang ningi nunguning aram.
Asele Barnabas Saul kupokko Tarsus namaram;

tom nu arigam, mu nu ilak peleman Antioch taiman. Se Barnabas Saul ilak yia suanta ko Antioch baga se, kariimet motam bibiya tala Kaem den nunga kasurukasan. Se Antioch sor te nuna giriman olekem alo mu nunga balman “Kris kariimet” maman.
Tom mu te prophet sang Jerusalem beteman ale Antioch tai kapa gilingiman.

Nunga ningi bo, ko nup Agabus, mu Bur saongam se barasam ale karak biya sor suen la Rome bitaruwara mu ningi kaparukko mu ko balam. (Karak biya mu Claudius Rome nunga Caesar bagaram se mel mu aratam.)
Se olekem alo suan suan nunga ikup guyak ko iki se nunga sikisaki Judea bagara mu nunga sangarmonko balman.
Ale nuna butata beteman, ale nunga nuguting mel mu Barnabas Saul nuguting te awuman, se giman ago nama nunga supuling alo nuguting te beteman.

footnotes.text: Prophet sang Antioch bagakasan: Acts 13:1; 15:32. Agabus: Acts 21:10-12.
